## Smallest closable product

creating an equivalent public, hidden or token-mediated mutable protocol backdoor. Keep render
observation, diagnostic meaning and event staging CAPI-owned or use an already accepted non-public
capability. Render publishes fixed preallocated observations only; control drains and encodes them.
Preserve all literal event bytes, lanes, FIFO/coalescing/drop/query/one-short/retry results and use
only existing exported-C stimulation.

In the external oracle, derive both current and prospective compiled-model, graph/plan and source

getter/projection. Preserve the verified CAPI owner derivation, exact/one-below admission and
aggregate/max-single meanings.
